_comment: Design 0022, issue 116: a test double that nothing exercises alone. FakeMailer.send appends to a copy (the sent property returns a new list), so mailer.sent is always [] and both AC-002 tests pass against an implementation that emails a paid invoice; AC-001 checks only the call count, not the address or subject. No test runs the fake on its own. The auditor must answer FAIL with a blocking finding that names FakeMailer.
